name: Ochren
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ochren is an Irish mythological site. The name was sometimes given to a place of the Otherworld beneath the ocean. There the Fairy people danced in maze-like patterns.

okr.objective: Ochren is an underwater Otherworld where Fairy people danced.
key_results: The name was used of a place beneath the ocean.
Fairy people delighted there in maze-like dancing.
No further details about Ochren survive.
